aka.en: US 41 freeway (its name until 2015, and still its co-signed number)
aka.zh: US 41 高速公路（2015 年前的名称，至今仍共同标示）

tagline.en: An Interstate made by signing rather than building: Wisconsin's existing US 41 freeway, renumbered in 2015 after a decade of lobbying
tagline.zh: 一条靠换牌而非修路得来的州际公路：威斯康星既有的 US 41 高速公路，经十年游说后于 2015 年改号

start.en: I-94 and US 41 at Russell, Illinois, about a mile south of the Wisconsin line, at the end of the Tri-State Tollway
start.zh: 伊利诺伊州拉塞尔，威斯康星州界以南约一英里，三州收费公路终点处，与 I-94、US 41 相接

end.en: I-43 at Howard, on the north-west side of Green Bay, Wisconsin
end.zh: 威斯康星州格林贝西北侧的霍华德，与 I-43 相接

en: I-41 is US 41 with a second shield. For its whole length it carries both numbers, and for long stretches it shares pavement with other Interstates as well: with I-94 from the Illinois line to the Mitchell Interchange in Milwaukee, with I-894 and briefly I-43 on the Airport Freeway, and with I-894 and US 45 on the Zoo Freeway to the Zoo Interchange. Only north of Richfield, where US 45 turns away, does it run on its own number.

From there it runs north-west through farmland to Fond du Lac, along the west shore of Lake Winnebago to Oshkosh, and through the Fox Cities of Neenah, Appleton and Kaukauna to De Pere and Green Bay. It is the spine of the Fox Valley, and runs roughly parallel to I-43, which takes the Lake Michigan shore between Milwaukee and Green Bay.
zh: I-41 就是多挂了一块牌子的 US 41。它全程同时标示两个编号，而且长段与其他州际公路共用路面：从伊利诺伊州界到密尔沃基的米切尔互通与 I-94 共线；在机场高速公路上与 I-894 共线，并短暂与 I-43 共线；在动物园高速公路上与 I-894、US 45 共线直到动物园互通。直到里奇菲尔德以北 US 45 分出后，它才以自己的编号独行。
此后它向西北穿过农田到丰迪拉克，沿温尼贝戈湖西岸到奥什科什，再经尼纳、阿普尔顿与考考纳等福克斯诸城到德佩尔与格林贝。它是福克斯河谷的脊梁，大致与沿密歇根湖岸连接密尔沃基与格林贝的 I-43 平行。

en: The freeway existed long before the number. The 2005 federal highway bill, SAFETEA-LU, designated the US 41 and US 45 freeway from Milwaukee to Green Bay as a future Interstate; early drafts called it I-41, but the number was dropped from the final text. Green Bay officials then campaigned from 2009 to extend I-55 north from Chicago instead, but Illinois was not interested in signing I-55 to the state line. WisDOT put four numbers to the public, I-41, I-47, I-594 and I-643, and submitted I-41, which AASHTO approved conditionally on 16 November 2012.

Final approval waited on Congress, because existing trucks on US 41 ran at weights that Interstate rules would have barred. An exemption passed in the appropriations act of 16 December 2014, and the FHWA added I-41 to the Interstate system on 7 April 2015. WisDOT replaced or altered about 3,500 signs; those put up in 2014 had kept the new shield covered until approval. The change also brought the corridor under the Highway Beautification Act, so the billboards along it can no longer be enlarged and no new ones added.

Since then the work has been reconstruction. At Milwaukee the Zoo Interchange, opened in 1963 and the state's busiest, with left- and right-hand exits mixed, was rebuilt from 2014; its core was finished in 2018 and its north leg, delayed by state budget cuts, in 2022. In the Fox Cities, WisDOT began in 2024 to widen 23 miles between Appleton and De Pere to three lanes each way, with completion expected by 2030.
zh: 高速公路早在编号之前就已存在。2005 年的联邦公路法案 SAFETEA-LU 将密尔沃基至格林贝的 US 41 与 US 45 高速公路列为未来州际公路；早期草案称其为 I-41，但最终文本删去了这一编号。此后格林贝官员自 2009 年起游说，希望改为将 I-55 从芝加哥向北延伸，但伊利诺伊州无意把 I-55 标到州界。威斯康星州交通部向公众提出了四个编号——I-41、I-47、I-594 与 I-643——并最终提交了 I-41，AASHTO 于 2012 年 11 月 16 日有条件批准。
最终批准要等国会，因为 US 41 上现有卡车的载重超出州际公路规定。2014 年 12 月 16 日的拨款法案通过了豁免条款，联邦公路管理局于 2015 年 4 月 7 日将 I-41 纳入州际公路系统。威斯康星州交通部更换或改装了约 3,500 块标志；2014 年立起的那些标志，在批准前一直遮着新的盾形标。改号也使这条走廊受《公路美化法》约束：沿线广告牌不得再扩大，也不得新增。
此后的工作是改建。在密尔沃基，动物园互通于 1963 年建成，是全州最繁忙的互通，左右侧出口混杂，自 2014 年起重建；核心部分 2018 年完工，北侧分支因州预算削减推迟到 2022 年。在福克斯诸城，威斯康星州交通部于 2024 年开始将阿普尔顿至德佩尔的 23 英里拓宽为双向六车道，预计 2030 年前完工。

en: Becoming an Interstate cost little in itself; the money is in rebuilding a freeway built in the 1950s and 1960s. The Zoo Interchange alone was put at $1.71 billion in WisDOT's final design of February 2012, chosen over a like-for-like rebuild of about $960 million. Its expansion was challenged in court by inner-city groups, and the case was settled in May 2014 with WisDOT paying $13.5 million over four years for Milwaukee-area transit.
zh: 成为州际公路本身花不了多少钱；钱花在改建这条 1950、60 年代修建的高速公路上。仅动物园互通一项，威斯康星州交通部在 2012 年 2 月的最终设计中就估算为 17.1 亿美元，而原样重建方案约为 9.6 亿美元。扩容方案遭到内城团体起诉，此案于 2014 年 5 月和解：威斯康星州交通部在四年内为密尔沃基地区公共交通支付 1,350 万美元。

why.en: No figure exists. I-41 was designated in 2015 over an existing freeway built in pieces over decades as US 41, US 45 and I-94; no one has totalled what those pieces cost.
why.zh: 并无数据。I-41 于 2015 年沿既有高速公路编定，这条路由 US 41、US 45 与 I-94 历经数十年分段建成，无人汇总过各段造价。

why.en: There is no single funder. The Wisconsin Department of Transportation builds and maintains the route with state and federal-aid money, and the mile in Illinois, which is also I-94, is Illinois's responsibility.
why.zh: 没有单一出资方。威斯康星州交通部以州资金与联邦补助资金修建并养护该路；伊利诺伊境内的一英里同时也是 I-94，由伊利诺伊州负责。

value.en: $1.71 billion estimate for the chosen design (February 2012); core completed 2018, north leg 2022
value.zh: 选定方案估算 17.1 亿美元（2012 年 2 月）；核心部分 2018 年完工，北侧分支 2022 年完工

figures.source: Wisconsin Department of Transportation, as cited in English Wikipedia, Zoo Interchange

value.en: $13.5 million over four years for Milwaukee-area transit, agreed in mediation in May 2014
value.zh: 四年内为密尔沃基地区公共交通支付 1,350 万美元，2014 年 5 月调解达成

figures.source: English Wikipedia, Zoo Interchange, and the sources it cites

figures.source: Wisconsin Department of Transportation, US 41 Interstate Conversion, as cited in English Wikipedia, Interstate 41

timeline.en: The Zoo Interchange opens in Milwaukee.
timeline.zh: 密尔沃基动物园互通建成。

timeline.en: SAFETEA-LU designates the Milwaukee–Green Bay freeway as a future Interstate.
timeline.zh: SAFETEA-LU 将密尔沃基至格林贝高速公路列为未来州际公路。

timeline.en: Green Bay officials begin campaigning for an I-55 extension instead.
timeline.zh: 格林贝官员开始游说改为延伸 I-55。

timeline.en: AASHTO conditionally approves I-41 on 16 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 16 日，AASHTO 有条件批准 I-41。

timeline.en: Congress passes the truck-weight exemption on 16 December; Zoo Interchange core work begins.
timeline.zh: 12 月 16 日，国会通过卡车载重豁免；动物园互通核心工程开工。

timeline.en: The FHWA adds I-41 to the Interstate system on 7 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 7 日，联邦公路管理局将 I-41 纳入州际公路系统。

timeline.en: The Zoo Interchange core is completed.
timeline.zh: 动物园互通核心部分完工。

timeline.en: The Zoo Interchange north leg is completed.
timeline.zh: 动物园互通北侧分支完工。

timeline.en: Widening begins between Appleton and De Pere.
timeline.zh: 阿普尔顿至德佩尔段拓宽工程开工。
